tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Free, no API key. Says whether a county is in the current data release, or lists every covered county in a state when no county is given. Parcel lookups in counties that are not covered cost no credits.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free, no API key. Returns the monthly API plans (price, included credits, overage per credit, rate limit), the credit cost of each lookup type and the one-off extract downloads. Statewide and nationwide licences are quoted at https://getparceldata.com/pricing.

tools.name: preview_area
tools.description: Free, no API key. Counts the parcels inside a bounding box, lists the counties it touches, and says whether the area fits the $49 extract of up to 5,000 parcels. Each side of the box can be up to 2 degrees. Limited to 30 requests per IP address per minute.

tools.name: find_parcels_by_apn
tools.description: Finds parcels by assessor parcel number (APN) in one county. Costs 1 credit per completed request, including no_match and ambiguous results. Up to 100 parcels per request. Validate each candidate before using it. Needs an API key. Lookups in counties we do not cover and failed requests cost no credi

tools.name: find_parcels_at_point
tools.description: Finds the parcels that contain a latitude and longitude. Costs 1 credit per request, however many parcels come back. Up to 1,000 parcels per request. Needs an API key. tools.description: Finds every parcel within a radius of a point, nearest first. Costs 3 credits per request, however many parcels come back. Radius up to 5,000 metres. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_parcels_by_apn" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
